descriptor.retrieval_description: Spherical citrus fruit with a textured peel substrate. The intended contact region is dry, convexly curved, and presents a slightly pebbled natural rind surface.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral opposing flanks of the spherical fruit
descriptor.local_geometry: Continuous convex spherical curvature with fine pitted texture
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: Clearly visible in the top-down view
descriptor.uncertainty: Exact compliance level of the inner pulp cannot be determined visually from the exterior peel.
